events.title: Battle of Mohács
events.description: Ottoman forces under Suleiman the Magnificent decisively defeated the Hungarian army of King Louis II at Mohács. Louis II died fleeing the battlefield, leaving the Hungarian throne vacant.
events.significance: The defeat ended Hungary's independence as a major kingdom, led to its partition among the Ottoman Empire, the Habsburgs and Transylvania, and shifted the balance of power in Central Europe.

events.title: Michael Faraday Demonstrates Electromagnetic Induction
events.description: On August 29, 1831, Michael Faraday conducted his first successful experiment showing electromagnetic induction, using an iron ring wound with two coils of wire to produce a transient current in one coil when current in the other changed.
events.significance: The discovery of electromagnetic induction became the foundation for electric generators, transformers and motors, underpinning modern electrical power technology.

events.title: First Soviet Atomic Bomb Test (RDS-1)
events.description: The Soviet Union detonated its first nuclear weapon, code-named RDS-1 (called 'Joe-1' by the West), at the Semipalatinsk test site in Kazakhstan.
events.significance: The test ended the United States' nuclear monopoly and accelerated the Cold War nuclear arms race.

events.title: Hurricane Katrina Makes Landfall in Louisiana
events.description: Hurricane Katrina struck the U.S. Gulf Coast as a Category 3 storm near Buras-Triumph, Louisiana, causing catastrophic flooding in New Orleans after levee failures. The disaster killed more than 1,800 people and displaced hundreds of thousands.
events.significance: Katrina was among the costliest and deadliest U.S. hurricanes, exposing failures in infrastructure and emergency response and prompting major reforms in disaster management and flood protection.

events.title: Birth of Michael Jackson
events.description: Michael Jackson, American singer, songwriter and dancer, was born in Gary, Indiana. He rose to fame with the Jackson 5 before becoming a global solo superstar with albums such as Off the Wall, Thriller and Bad.
events.significance: Known as the 'King of Pop,' Jackson transformed popular music, music videos and live performance, and Thriller remains one of the best-selling albums of all time.
